40826.title: The Key to Karazhan VII

40827.task: Slay Immol'thar in Dire Maul, retrieve gems from his skin
40827.text: Slay Immol'thar in Dire Maul, retrieve gems from his skin, and return to Vandol.
40827.title: The Key to Karazhan VIII

40828.task: Find "Treatise on Magical Locks and Keys"

40828.title: The Key to Karazhan IX

40829.task: Witness the reforging of the Key to the Upper Chambers
40829.text: Witness the reforging of the Key to the Upper Chambers.

40958.title: Into the Dream II

40959.text: Gather a Binding Fragment from Cliff Breakers in Azshara, Overloaded Arcane Prism from Arcane Torrents in the Western wing of Dire Maul and a Slumberer's Shard from Weaver in the Sunken Temple. Report to Itharius in the Swamp of Sorrows with the collected items.

40962.title: Into the Dream VI

41015.task: Gather the Upper Binding of Xanthar and the Lower Binding of Xanthar

41015.title: The Binding of Xanthar

41083.text: Find a Comfortable Pillow for Councilman Kyleson in Karazhan.
41083.title: Suitable Accomodations

41084.text: Speak with someone who may know how to acquire wine for Councilman Kyleson.
41084.title: A Drink to Sleep

41085.text: Gather 3 Essence of Death, 5 Flask of Port, and a Ghost Mushroom for The Cook in Karazhan.

41311.text: Slay the doomguard Dolvan was informing you about and return with the Clutch of Thanlar. He awaits you at his home south of Theramore.
41311.title: Bovar'kez

41312.task: If you wish to repair the relic, bring Dolvan the necessary parts and an arcane focus from a high-ranking blue dragon. The mage can be found along the shoreline south of Theramore: Gemstone of Kara, Gemstone of Zhan

41370.title: Tirisfal's Vestige

41371.task: Attune the raging, alien magics within the Scepter of Medivh by bringing a source of similar magic: Pure Draenethyst Gemstone

4182.title: Dragonkin Menace

4183.text: Travel to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn's Letter to Magistrate Solomon.
4183.title: The True Masters

4184.text: Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.  Bolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.
4184.title: The True Masters

4185.text: Speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon after speaking with Lady Katrana Prestor.
4185.title: The True Masters

4186.text: Take Bolvar's Decree to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
4186.title: The True Masters

4223.text: Speak with Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes.
4223.title: The True Masters

4224.text: Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor's fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task.  You recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for him in a cave to the north.
4224.title: The True Masters

4241.text: Travel to Blackrock Mountain in the northwest and enter Blackrock Depths. Find out what became of Marshal Windsor.  You recall Ragged John talking about Windsor being dragged off to a prison.
4241.title: Marshal Windsor

4242.text: Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.
4242.title: Abandoned Hope

4264.text: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.
4264.title: A Crumpled Up Note

4282.task: Return Marshal Windsor's Lost Information.  Marshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge
4282.text: Return Marshal Windsor's Lost Information.  Marshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge.
4282.title: A Shred of Hope

4322.text: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.
4322.title: Jail Break!

4742.task: Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe: Unadorned Seal of Ascension
4742.text: Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan.  The Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn; Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone; and Overlord Wyrmthalak  of the Bloodaxe.
4742.title: Seal of Ascension

4743.task: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken.  It is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the Orb of Draconic Energy on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties. Control the beast and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension
4743.text: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken.  It is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the Orb of Draconic Energy on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties. Control the beast and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension!
4743.title: Seal of Ascension

4903.task: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents
4903.text: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
4903.title: Warlord's Command

4941.title: Eitrigg's Wisdom

4974.task: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head
4974.text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.
4974.title: For The Horde!

5066.text: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist.  His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.
5066.title: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

5092.task: Kill 10 Skeletal Flayers and 10 Slavering Ghouls in Sorrow Hill
5092.text: Kill 10 Skeletal Flayers and 10 Slavering Ghouls in Sorrow Hill.  Return to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
5092.title: Clear the Way

5093.text: Seek out High Executor Derrington.  His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.
5093.title: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

5096.task: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent.  Place the Scourge banner at the camp: Flame in a Bottle
5096.text: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent.  Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
5096.title: Scarlet Diversions

5097.task: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.  Once all four towers are marked
5097.text: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.  Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to Commander Ashlam Valorfist in Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
5097.title: All Along the Watchtowers

5098.task: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.  Once all four towers are marked
5098.text: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.  Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
5098.title: All Along the Watchtowers

5514.title: Mold Rhymes With...

5533.title: Scholomance

5801.text: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater.  Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.  Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

5802.text: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater.  Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.  Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5803.task: Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab

5804.text: Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
5804.title: Araj's Scarab

6402.text: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.
6402.title: Stormwind Rendezvous

6403.text: Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!
6403.title: The Great Masquerade

6501.text: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.
6501.title: The Dragon's Eye

6502.task: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire
6502.text: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.
6502.title: Drakefire Amulet

6567.text: Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas.
6567.title: The Champion of the Horde

6568.text: Deliver Rexxar's Testament to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.
6568.title: The Testament of Rexxar

6569.task: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes
6569.text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.
6569.title: Oculus Illusions

6570.text: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.
6570.title: Emberstrife

6582.task: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse
6582.text: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife.  You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.
6582.title: The Test of Skulls, Scryer

6583.task: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull
6583.text: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.
6583.title: The Test of Skulls, Somnus

6584.task: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him
6584.text: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.
6584.title: The Test of Skulls, Chronalis

6585.task: Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull
6585.text: Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.
6585.title: The Test of Skulls, Axtroz

6601.text: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.
6601.title: Ascension...

6602.task: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
6602.text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.
6602.title: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion

7487.task: Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment
7487.text: Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment. Return to Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain when you have recovered the Core Fragment.
7487.title: Attunement to the Core

7761.text: That is one stupid orc. It would appear as if you need to find this brand and gain the Mark of Drakkisath in order to access the Orb of Command.  The letter indicates that General Drakkisath guards the brand. Perhaps you should investigate.
7761.title: Blackhand's Command

7848.task: Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment
7848.text: Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment. Return to Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain when you have recovered the Core Fragment.
7848.title: Attunement to the Core

838.title: Scholomance
